purpose: Physical bench protocol for transferring the MuJoCo vial-triage policy to a real five-finger hand without overstating that hardware tests were already run.
status: hardware protocol prepared; simulated acceptance metrics generated by this repository
recommended_hardware: five-finger dexterous hand with thumb opposition and fingertip force sensing
6-DoF wrist or gantry with at least xyz translation and wrist roll
AprilTag or ArUco marker board around the vial tray for camera calibration
thin medicine-vial surrogate with removable cap and compliant sterile-pod target
force-limited emergency stop and 20 Hz telemetry logger
calibration_steps: Calibrate camera-to-base transform with a 6x6 marker board; require reprojection error below 1.5 px.
Map MuJoCo hand frame to hardware palm frame; require vial grasp-site pose error below 8 mm.
Measure empty-grip fingertip offsets and set per-finger contact thresholds.
Run the no-vial dry trajectory at 30% speed and verify no joint-limit or self-collision warnings.

physical_test_matrix.pass_condition: no crush events and cap removed in >= 6/8 trials
slip recovered within 1.5 s in >= 6/8 trials

evidence_to_collect_on_hardware: vial pose estimate and final placement error
slip recovery timestamp and residual action norm
